test_title: PYST 18: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 14th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Deny
solution:
The correct answer is **Agree.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Deny:** to refuse to admit or accept something.
 
• **Agree: **to have the same opinion as somebody/something.
 
• Thus, the correct antonym of **Deny** is** Agree**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Deflate: **to become or to make something smaller by letting the air or gas out of it.
 
• **Mourn: **to feel and show great sadness, especially because somebody has died.
 
• **Exhaust: **the waste gas that comes out of a vehicle.
